items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: All the guys used to sit in, like the Basie band, not the band, but guys in the band you know

ctx.x: Yes I do. Those white guys can really swing, huh?

Oh I had a lot of black players, they used to come in, like they would take me down the hall and then where Minton’s was, and then there was another place down there. All the guys used to sit in, like the Basie band, not the band, but guys in the band you know, and they’d bring me down the hall and they liked me, I don’t know. They’d just take me around, they’d protect me.
